mentions.name: Wireworld Circuit HDL
mentions.description: A hobby hardware description language (HDL) for designing circuits in Wireworld and other cellular automata. The eventual goal is to build a larger Wireworld computer than the original, with possible later work optimizing large Conway's Game of Life designs. The compiler/solver is being written in Rust without AI assistance as a learning project, and a WIP language spec is published as a gist.
mentions.source_excerpt: Implementing a hobby HDL for designing circuits in Wireworld and other Cellular Automata. The eventual goal is to create a larger Wireworld computer than the original (https://www.quinapalus.com/wi-index.html). If this project actually ends up working, I may attempt to optimise some large Conway's Game of Life designs. Currently I'm at the stage of rewriting the language's solver.
